caption:
An ode to Dubai: the city that never gives up 💌This isn’t just a skyline: it’s a feeling 📸🤌

Between desert silence and city lights, Dubai feels like a story that’s always unfolding. From golden hour in the dunes to reflections dancing across glass towers, every frame changes in seconds. It’s the kind of place where you don’t chase moments - you stay ready for them.

I loved shooting this on the @sonyalphain A6700: fast, intuitive, and built to keep up: whether it’s harsh sun, soft dusk, or everything in between. Light enough to carry all day, powerful enough to capture it the way it felt.

Because the best travel stories aren’t planned-they’re noticed. Because Farak Padta Hai 🤍📸

2022 in 10 photos 🌍🐧December is here - that time of the year where all of us look back, express gratitude, and SET INTENTIONS for the coming year 😊🗓 

Here are some memorable highlights of 2022 for us ⬆️ 

•We explored 9 new countries & revisited several old favourites ✈️ 
•Published a book & it became a best-seller within days, thanks to all of you 📕 
• Continued our dream of spreading education by building a computer lab for kids who did not have access to digital education 💻 
•Vid continued to spoil every single selfie we took but nothing new there 🤣
•Shot a global campaign for Ted Baker’s website & stores worldwide 📺 
•Launched Thailand tourisms’ new chapter as a Responsible destination 🇹🇭 
•Received lots of accolades for our work from being featured in Forbes list of 100 Digital Stars to Cosmo Travel Blogger of the year 🏆 
•Met so many of you at book signings, airports, and meet-ups in far-away lands from Kenya to Chile - always so special. I might be biased but Bruisedpassports fam is the BEST 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦
•And perhaps most importantly, in a world full of crumbling half-baked relationships, I’m MOST GRATEFUL to be surrounded by an incredible partner and amazing friends and family💗

caption:
The best days start with a boarding pass am I right? ✈️🌍

We’re off on an epic adventure on @flyswiss Business Class from Delhi to USA via Zurich. Seamless check-ins, elegant lounges, thoughtfully-curated dining, exceptional cabin comfort, and the all-new SWISS Senses experience on the A350 made this a reminder of why the journey matters just as much as the destination. We loved the new seats, designed like luxurious mini cocoons with lie-flat beds, and so much privacy ✈️

And one of our favorite moments is always spending time at the SWISS Lounge in Zurich during transit, turning a layover into something we genuinely looked forward to. Where else will you find SWISS chocolates at every corner and a viewing platform to see flights take off 🍫✈️

And if Switzerland has been on your radar, there’s more good news:
✈️ The second daily Delhi-Zurich service is now available until 13 September 2026, making connections even more convenient.
✈️ Plus, SWISS will launch a direct Bengaluru–Zurich route from 28 October 2026, with seamless connections to the US. The route is now available for booking.

This is what long-haul travel looks like when every detail is designed to flow seamlessly. Because great travel isn’t just about where you’re going-it’s about how you get there. ✨
Let’s collect some stamps and stories shall we? ✈️🌍

Japan in April 🥺🌸🌸🌸

Cherry Blossom Season in Japan (Sakura 2026 Guide + Best Spots!) 🇯🇵✨

If you’re searching for the best time to visit Japan for cherry blossoms, this is your sign 🌸 The magical sakura season in Japan typically peaks between late March and early April, transforming the country into a dreamy pink wonderland 💖

Japan is truly unlike ANY other country in the world! Most people wait for cherry blossom season, but honestly the country is a delight to visit all year round. Here are 6 reasons you need to visit Japan pronto 🇯🇵 ✨
	•	The mountains, especially the iconic Mt. Fuji and the Japanese Alps around Hakuba 💙
	•	Tokyo, which is endlessly fascinating in SO many different ways 💙
	•	Safe and insanely efficient public transport 💙
	•	Disneyland (coz why not?!) 💙
	•	Shinto shrines & traditional wooden houses in historical towns like Kyoto 💙
	•	The food. Wait I need to say this again and louder THE FOOD 😋😋

If you are going during Sakura season in Japan, them here are the Best Cherry Blossom Spots in Japan 🌸
• Ueno Park, Tokyo (perfect for hanami picnics)
• Shinjuku Gyoen, Tokyo (calm + aesthetic vibes)
• Philosopher’s Path, Kyoto (dreamy canal walks)
• Arashiyama, Kyoto (bamboo + sakura combo 😍)
• Osaka Castle Park, Osaka (iconic views!)
• Mount Yoshino, Nara (thousands of cherry trees 🌸)
• Himeji Castle (Japan’s most beautiful castle backdrop 🏯)
• Hakuba Valley (snowy mountains + blossoms 💙)

Have you been to Japan or is it on your bucket list? 🇯🇵😊 There’s a detailed guide to planning and packing for a trip to Japan on the Bruised Passports App 😊💙💙

5 Favourite perfumes - all details below ⬇️☺️ Valentine’s Day is around here the corner, so I HAD to dedicate this weeks Travel Beauty video to our favourite perfumes for men & women! If you’ve been following us for a while, you would know how much of a fragrance geek I am. These are some of our favourites at the moment if you want to smell like a snacc this V Day (I had to 😅)⬇️

•Tom Ford - Black Orchid
Luxurious, classy, the magic is in dry down so let it sit on your skin for an hour before you decide how you like it
https://nyk0.page.link/FSuaxgU8xC9xUeF47

•Jo Malone - Wood Sage & Sea Salt
Earthy, unique, sensual, not the longest lasting
https://nyk0.page.link/X7LjL5B8gJrz7cXb7

•Jo Malone - Similar but longer lasting
https://nyk0.page.link/peFk4TnCJwq9LKf19

•YSL Libre - Really nice fragrance for casual date nights, work, winter days
https://nyk0.page.link/XD7uZxzeffDMqT6o9

•Montale Oud Tobacco- least favourite bottle but the fragrance is amazing! 

•Miller Harris Scherzo - A license store or @scentidoindia if you’re in India. Please do give them a sniff if you are around a shop. There are lots of fakes floating around online, so be careful where you purchase th
from
